10 REM UART1600 SL V1.0: SAVER AND LOADER OF BASIC PROGRAMS, 19200 BPS
20 REM PC-1600 MODE 0. TX=CN9 PIN 29, RX=CN9 PIN 27. USE AS DIRECT COMMANDS
30 CLEAR:WAIT 0:BEEP OFF
40 A=0:INPUT "ML ADDRESS (ENTER=49349) ";A
50 IF A=0 THEN LET A=49349
60 IF A<49152 OR A>64000 THEN LET A=0:GOTO 40
70 RESTORE 1000:READ N:C=0
80 FOR S=1 TO N:READ O,L
90 FOR I=0 TO L-1:READ B:POKE A+O+I,B:C=C+B:NEXT I
100 NEXT S
110 READ X:IF X<>C THEN GOTO 900
120 P=PEEK(65084)+256*PEEK(65085)
130 Q=PEEK(65087)+256*PEEK(65088)
140 IF Q<P OR P<32768 THEN GOTO 910
150 CLS:PRINT "UART1600 SL READY"
160 PRINT "SAVE: CALL ";A;",X"
170 PRINT "LOAD: CALL ";A+176;",X"
180 PRINT "PROGRAM ";P;" TO ";Q
190 END
900 PRINT "DATA ERROR: CHECK THE LISTING":BEEP 3:END
910 PRINT "POINTERS?":PRINT P;" ";Q:BEEP 3:END
